content.text:
I fixed the regression in `anthrouter/http_util.py`. The requests-remaining entry in `_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` read `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining` (singular). Upstream sends `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so that value was never recorded in the rate-limit window. I changed it to the plural form.

I didn't run the full suite. I ran only the rate-limit and `proxy-status` tests (selected by name), and all 6 pass.
